peer_identity.honcho_notes: Merge: same person, cross-volume id drift. Prefer baron-berard-of-castaka as it carries the dynasty name.
peer_identity.rationale: baron-berard-of-castaka (vol02) and baron_berard (vol01) are the same character extracted under two character_ids due to naming inconsistency between volumes. Both are single-record singletons with no phase split. 'baron-berard-of-castaka' is the more specific and complete identifier and should be canonical.
